name: Tab claim
summary: Everyone taps what they ate off one person's receipt; the rest splits evenly and totals update live.
useWhen: one person paid a restaurant bill and others owe for what they ordered
'I got Smokey's, claim your stuff', 'who had the ribs'
dontUseWhen: an even split with no items (use split-even)

payer.description: Name of the member who put it on their card, exactly as in the members list

tipBps.description: Tax and tip together in basis points (2200 = 22 in 100)

claimedBy.description: Member name who already claimed it in the chat, or an empty string
